summary.name: TablePlus
summary.one_liner: TablePlus is a modern, native GUI tool for managing and querying many relational and non-relational databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, Redis and MongoDB.
use_cases: edit database rows and table structure directly
migrate a database via SQL dump export and import
connect to multiple databases at once
protect production databases with safe mode
build internal dashboards with a metrics board
summary.what_it_does: TablePlus is a GUI for working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite and Oracle, plus Redis, MongoDB, ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake and others. It supports inline editing of data rows, table structure and query results, along with multiple advanced filters for finding records. It includes a code review view of changes, a safe mode to guard production databases, and SQL dump export and import. Users can jump quickly to any table, schema, view or function, and open multiple tabs and windows across connections. A Metrics Board feature is mentioned for building dashboards, and a JavaScript plugin system is in beta.
notable: Native app design for each OS
Safe mode to prevent mistakes on production databases
Broad database support including Redis, MongoDB, ClickHouse, DuckDB and Turso
Inline editing and code review of changes
caveats: Limitless extensibility plugin system is in beta
Pricing details are not stated on the page
